# TEXITcoin

> TEXITcoin (TXC) is a Layer 1, proof-of-work digital currency mined in Texas — sound money for a sovereign Lone Star State.

TEXITcoin is a community-driven cryptocurrency built for everyday peer-to-peer use: fast 3-minute blocks, Scrypt proof-of-work, no pre-mine, 353,396,296 TXC max supply, and a foundation rooted in honest money and Texas independence. Omni Layer 2 runs on TEXITcoin, not Bitcoin.
